guide.title: Installation, step by step
guide.subtitle: Follow the steps in order. BIOS option names may differ on your PC.
guide.step1.title: 1. Check your hardware
guide.step1.body: Scan your PC or import Report.json. Choose macOS and review graphics, network and storage limitations. Building requires an ACPI folder with the DSDT from the same PC.
guide.step2.title: 2. Prepare the BIOS
guide.step2.body: Save your current BIOS settings. If Windows uses BitLocker, save the recovery key before making changes. Do not change RAID/VMD/AHCI without preparing the installed OS.
guide.bios.check_hint: Only tick settings you have checked in the BIOS. These checkboxes do not change the BIOS.
guide.bios.secure: Secure Boot disabled for OpenCore boot
guide.bios.storage: Storage mode checked: AHCI, VMD disabled if needed
guide.bios.bar: Re-Size BAR reviewed for the selected GPU
guide.bios.intel: Intel: CFG Lock, VT-d and DVMT reviewed against the configuration; iGPU usually needs at least 64 MiB DVMT
guide.step3.title: 3. Build the EFI
guide.step3.body: Open OpenCore EFI, select macOS and your ACPI folder. Choose “Build and check EFI”. Continue after validation succeeds. Complex laptops may need custom ACPI patches.
guide.step4.title: 4. Download Apple Recovery
guide.step4.body: After building, choose “Next: download Apple Recovery”. An internet connection is required. Wait for the download and verification to finish.
guide.step5.title: 5. Prepare the USB drive
guide.step5.body: Connect an 8–128 GiB USB drive and refresh the drive list. Check the model, size and serial number. Back up needed files: writing erases all data on the selected USB. Enter the exact path and start writing. Alternatively, create an image file without modifying drives.
guide.step5.warning: Do not select a drive containing data you need.
guide.step6.title: 6. Boot and test the result
guide.step6.body: Open the UEFI Boot Menu and select the USB. Choose Recovery in OpenCore; macOS installation uses the internet. Check the target disk before formatting. After installation, test networking, audio, USB, displays and sleep. Keep the installer USB until internal-disk boot has been tested.
guide.nvidia: NVIDIA may need a separate driver after macOS installation. External-display support does not imply support for the laptop’s built-in display.
guide.troubleshoot.title: If something goes wrong
guide.troubleshoot.body: Build failed: check the ACPI folder and iasl path. Drive missing: refresh the list and open the blocking reason. Download failed: check your connection and retry. EFI does not boot: review BIOS and hardware; enable the detailed boot log in advanced settings. Error details are available in the activity log.
mac.prepare_host: Use your Mac to prepare an EFI for another PC. Import its Report.json and ACPI; Apple Silicon is not an x86 OpenCore target.
build.plan_unavailable: A configuration could not be selected. Review hardware limitations and the selected macOS.
